sourceRefs.locator: Introduction and description of f. 128v, lines 1–4: Bede completed the History in 731; early copy and three lines of Northumbrian verse in the main scribe’s hand.
Introduction, opening discussion of Bede, Ecclesiastical History I.1, British and English, and the changing languages of Britain.
Book IV, chapter 24, opening narrative and verses: the feast, animals at Whitby, the dream, the Latin rendering of the English hymn.
National Heritage List for England 1002978, Location, National Grid Reference NZ 33870 65184.

note.de: Der Mönch beendet in Wearmouth-Jarrow seine lateinische Geschichte. Die Karte zeigt den Klosterstandort Jarrow. Eine frühe Abschrift bewahrt Cædmons Lied zusätzlich in altenglischer Sprache.
note.en: Bede completes his Latin history at Wearmouth-Jarrow. The map marks the Jarrow monastery site. An early copy also preserves Cædmon’s hymn in Old English.
